scope: Reuse prior idle-game research and re-read two primary design sources for the actual finite-choice and feedback gaps. No competitor playtest or compatibility claim.

sources.title: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 116: Time limits
sources.fact: The guidance distinguishes non-core UI time limits from core gameplay timers; dialogue can persist until the player advances it.
sources.inference: This project's story and question remain untimed while reading. Only after an explicit selected action is confirmed does its online period start. Countdown expiry never chooses a new answer.
sources.limitation: This source does not prescribe idle-game action seconds, growth pacing, or resource budgets. Those are unbalanced project parameters in 0009.

sources.title: Clarity in League
sources.fact: Riot describes readable gameplay, importance-based visual hierarchy, and restrained visual noise.
sources.inference: Use existing character/scene imagery and distinct dialogue, breakthrough, trial and closure effects only for a newly persisted current action; keep the actual result readable after the short effect and avoid duplicate central overlays.
sources.limitation: Competitive combat examples are not this game's rules, art acceptance, or evidence that its current UI is clear to a human player.

implementationAndHumanAcceptance: Recorded separately after actual verification; research alone closes neither.
